# GraphEvent

`schemas/records/graph-event.json`

The payload of every artifact-graph node event (docs/design/m0/13), discriminated by type: node.recorded/v1 and node.claimed/v1, under the node's id and in its project. internal/graph folds them into the graph projections in the writer transaction and refuses one its state does not derive. Result and selection events follow (plan 15 G3-2).

A document is one of: [NodeRecorded](#noderecorded) or [NodeClaimed](#nodeclaimed).

## Definitions

### NodeRecorded

A node joins its task's graph, append-only: its task, its project and the node it succeeds (null for a first round).

#### Fields of NodeRecorded

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_recorded` |  |
| `node` | yes | [node](records-node.md) |  |
| `task` | yes | [TaskID](common-defs.md#taskid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `predecessor` | yes | null or [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeClaimed

A node's claim on its computation key (13 [G10]): its inputs as they resolved, fixed from here on, and the key they give. A claim is a node instance's: a repeat demand of the node joins it and records nothing; a memoizable kind's key is claimed once per task.

#### Fields of NodeClaimed

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_claimed` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |
| `inputs` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-nodeclaimedinputs)) | Each declared input and what it resolved to, in declared order: a result, or an approval with its revision. A new kind of resolution is a new event version (node.claimed/v2), since every field is required. |

No other fields are allowed.

#### Fields of NodeClaimed.inputs[]

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |
| `result` | yes | null or [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) |  |
| `approval` | yes | null or [ApprovalID](common-defs.md#approvalid) |  |
| `revision` | yes | null or integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
